name: LoopFormer-Fixed2
tagline: Condition shared computation on time and step size.
description: A fixed-two-recursion adaptation from the historical native experiment. Time and step-size conditioning modulate the shared core’s input and residual update. FP32 normalization and bounded modulation limit amplification.
paperTitle: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation
mechanism: 3 prelude + 9 core blocks × 2 recursions + 3 coda, for 24 block executions
Time t = 0 or 1/2, with step size dt = 1/2
FP32 conditional RMSNorm, 0.5 × tanh offsets and a separate low-learning-rate AdamW group
limitations: No short paths, teacher or consistency objective. This Fixed2 adaptation is not the paper’s complete elastic-depth recipe.
